# beowulf-fitt-39 — cruces rendered as guesses

| line | word | choice | reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2836–2839 | first `þæt` (… lȳt manna ðāh … `þæt` hē … gerǣsde) | first `þæt` taken as anticipating the second; "few throve in this: that he should rush …" | the construction is unclear; no lexical help |
| 2843 | dryhtmāðma | "lord-treasures" (`l`), "noble treasures" (`i`) | `dryht-` as "noble" is a guess from compounds; hapax-like |
| 2856–2857 | wiht | "anything" (object of oncirran); Thorpe et al. read `willan` | kept Klaeber; noted variant |
| 2858 | dǣdum rǣdan | "rule in deeds over each of men"; subject `dōm Godes` | loose dative construction |
| 2869–2870 | forwurpe … wrāðe | `wrāðe` "bitterly" (`l`), "in vain" (`i`) | adverb of wrāð; sense of wasted gifts inferred |
| 2874 | Nealles … gylpan þorfte | "had no need (cause) to boast" | þurfan + negative; idiom inferred |
| 2878 | ætgifan | "give" (Klaeber notes perhaps `gifan`) | same sense either way |
| 2879 | mǣges helpan | genitive object of helpan, "help the kinsman" | helpan takes gen./dat. |
| 2880–2882 | of gewitte | "out of the wit" (`l`), "from his head" (`i`); gewitt = seat of mind | usual sense gives no source for the fire |
| 2880–2881 | symle wæs þȳ sǣmra | subject (dragon) supplied; Sievers/Holthausen read `þone … -genīðla` | noted variant only |
| 2886 | lufen | "love" (`l`), "all that is dear" (`i`); alternatives `leofen` ("sustenance"), `lēofum`, `lungre` | disputed word |
| 2886–2887 | londrihtes mōt … īdel hweorfan | `mōt` "must" (`i`), "must" (`l`) | mōt "may/must", bitter irony; īdel + gen. "empty of land-right" |
| 2852 | wlitan | short-i preterite plural "looked" (Klaeber); others `wlītan` infinitive | metrically/grammatically ambiguous |
| 2828 | him / hine | followed Klaeber `him`, noted `hine` | fornīman normally takes acc. |
| 2829 | heaðoscearde | "battle-notched"; Thorpe et al. `-scearpe` "battle-sharp" | noted variant |
| 2824–2826 | bealwe gebǣded | "pressed by bale" | gebǣdan "force, oppress", sense of "overcome" a guess |
